services_provided_as_business: The assessed office is carrying on a business in providing those same services. Supply through case-specific judgment considering occupation or duty requiring attention, continuity, capacity for profit and profit purpose, without treating the list as an exhaustive conjunction. business_carried_on_in_hong_kong: The same business providing the assessed services is carried on in Hong Kong, as determined from the circumstances. This is not merely the location of clients, shared premises or an unrelated business. (truth value)
Scope: true
Result: all of these conditions hold: [the fact services_are_regulated; the fact services_provided_as_business; the fact business_carried_on_in_hong_kong]
